messages:
jamie_support: FYI escalating ACME-452 — onboarding customer, flagged 'renewal at risk' after seeing 3x latency since last night. They hit a hard SLO during demo. Please prioritize.
olivia_csm: Thanks Jamie. Can you paste the error pattern and the last few logs? Also who from eng can take immediate look? We should get a short comms plan before the EOD call with the customer. @matt_se? :eyes:
matt_se: I'll pick this up. Initial guess: new model variant + larger sequence lengths causing batch blowups. Can we confirm model id + recent deploy? jamie_support, share model id.
jamie_support: Model: redwood-v2-medium-2026-05. Deploy tag: canary-74. Logs: `429 throttle` spikes, tail latencies hitting 1.2s/token (was ~0.3s/token). Attached first sample: ```
[2026-03-23T22:14:51Z] request id=acme-req-121 size=2048 seq=1024 model=redwood-v2-medium-2026-05 latency=1250ms
[2026-03-23T22:15:12Z] request id=acme-req-122 size=256 seq=32 model=redwood-v2-medium-2026-05 latency=1180ms
``` 
No infra alerts but sustained lat increase.
sara_cs: Oliva — lean on me for the comms. Proposal: 1) Immediate triage + rollback option; 2) Customer-facing note acknowledging we're investigating and proposing a quick troubleshooting call in the next 1-2 hrs; 3) Follow-up with remediation + credit if SLA breach. Want to draft short template now.
olivia_csm: Yes. Draft for customer (1-2 sentences): "We're aware of increased latency affecting your demos. Our engineering team is actively investigating; we'll propose a troubleshooting call within 1 hour and share an interim mitigation plan." Anyone edit?
matt_se: Add: "We may temporarily route your traffic to a previous stable model variant to restore latency while we finish the root cause." Also I'll start a canary rollback test now and report in 20m.
jamie_support: +1 on rollback. I will notify the customer PV (account exec) and set up call for 20:45 PT. Also flagging renewal manager @sara_cs for potential churn messaging.
lex_engineer: From infra side — queue depth on dedicated pool spiked with larger sequence lengths; KV cache pressure observed. Suggest applying batch cap (max_tokens_per_batch=512) as an immediate mitigation and enable prefix caching for ACME workspace. I'll put a patch in staging.
deploy-bot: Deployment canary rollback job started: job-id cb-rollback-174993. Estimated time 8m.
olivia_csm: Great. Comms plan: I'll send customer note now and request 20:45 PT. Template below; please approve quickly.
olivia_csm: "Hi Sam — quick note: we are aware of increased latency in your environment since yesterday. Our engineers are investigating and are running a rollback test now to restore normal performance. Can we hop on a 20‑minute troubleshooting call at 20:45 PT? We'll share findings and next steps during the call. — Olivia"
matt_se: Approved. If rollback restores perf, we'll keep customer on previous model and schedule a controlled re-rollout with smaller batch settings and KV caching enabled.
sara_cs: I'll prepare a renewal-risk internal blurb for RevOps: one-line summary + recommended credit policy. Will post in the account thread after the call.
jamie_support: Thank you team — I'll update ACME in 10m with the invite. Keep me posted here with any infra/rollback status.
lex_engineer: Patch applied to staging for batch cap; rolling to canary in 3m. If observed tail latency drops below 400ms/token after cap, we'll push to production.
matt_se: Canary metrics show tail at ~380ms/token after cap. Pre-rollback baseline ~300ms. Proceeding with rollback to stable tag redwood-v2-medium-2026-04.
deploy-bot: Rollback to redwood-v2-medium-2026-04 completed: job-id cb-rollback-174993 status=success.
jamie_support: Customer notified: they accepted 20:45 PT call. They appreciate the quick action. Marking this as P1 escalation handled; will leave open until post-call notes and credit decision.
olivia_csm: Post-call action items: 1) Confirm SLA impact window and compute credit (Sara), 2) Create runbook entry for sequence-length regression (Matt/Lex), 3) Schedule follow-up deployment with conservative batch settings (Eng). I'll draft the customer follow-up email.
sara_cs: On it — will ping RevOps and Sales for renewal touchpoint template.
matt_se: Logging root cause: uncontrolled sequence-length distribution after model update exposed batching heuristic bug. I'll open PR with fix and include regression test.
jamie_support: Closing loop here after follow-up email. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
